claims: Mexico Legends and Brazil Legends played a 2-2 draw on April 19, 2026.
The match between Mexico Legends and Brazil Legends was at Estadio Banorte (or Estadio Azteca per initial scheduling).
The match between Mexico Legends and Brazil Legends was an exhibition match.
Oribe Peralta scored twice for Mexico Legends.
Brazil Legends squad was led by 1970 champion Jairzinho.
Mexico Legends included Rafa Márquez, Jared Borgetti, Oswaldo Sánchez, Miguel Layún, Andrés Guardado, and Cuauhtémoc Blanco.
Brazil Legends included Ronaldinho, Kaká, Adriano, Gilberto Silva, and Jairzinho.
Mexico Legends played a 5-5 draw against FIFA World Legends in Jan 2026.
Mexico Legends won 3-2 on penalties against FIFA World Legends.
FIFA World Legends included Xavi, Del Piero, Cafu
